translation.name: Seongsu First-Timer Highlights
translation.summary: A compact first visit to Seongsu combining its creative streets, K-beauty, photo culture, Seoul Forest and a local meal.
translation.description: This half-day route is designed for a first visit to Seongsu. It starts with the neighborhood's signature creative street atmosphere, adds an interactive K-beauty stop and a quick self-photo experience, then slows down in Seoul Forest before ending with a classic local food option. Pop-up schedules and store hours change often, so treat the route as a flexible framework rather than a fixed timetable.

stops.note: Start by walking the main creative street and checking current pop-ups.
Explore K-beauty experiences; some personalized services may require reservations.
Choose a booth concept that matches your style rather than picking the first one you see.
Use the park as the slower middle section of the route.
Finish with a local meal; individual restaurant hours and queues vary.
